posts.title: One Network. Two Clocks. Why Canada-US Companies Still Do Not Have a North American Security Program
posts.description: A practical North American security model for identity, data residency, AI agents, and dual incident clocks under PIPEDA, Bill C-8, CIRCIA, CPCSC, and CMMC.
posts.author: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
posts.quote: The border is a legal fact. It is not a network boundary.
